pr_body:
Currently we don't report any exceptions occuring during `field_caps` requestrs back to the user.
This PR adds a new `failure` section to the response which contains exceptions per index, keyed by
the index name the error occured in. In addition the response contains another field `failed_indices`
which reports the number of indices that threw an exception. If all of the requested indices failed,
the whole request fails with a 500 error code, otherwise the request succeeds and it is up to the caller
to check for potential errors in the response body.

Closes #68994

issue_context.title: Field capabilities API drops shard level exceptions
comments:
What I learned from debugging so far:
* we throw a `MapperParsingException` when parsing the bad section in RuntimeFieldType#parseRuntimeFields
* this exception gets handled and forwarded by `TransportResponseHandler#onFailure` in `TransportFieldCapabilitiesIndexAction` which passes it on to `TransportFieldCapabilitiesIndexAction#onFailure`
* this triggers some `tryNext()` strategy for iterating shards, but since for this call we have `canMatchShard` set to false, only the listeners `onResponse` is called

Even when then listeners `onFailure` would get called, I guess we still have something missing in the ActionListener in `TransportFieldCapabilitiesAction` (see [TODO here](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/master/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/fieldcaps/TransportFieldCapabilitiesAction.java#L98) which I guess needs to be adressed to properly pass on errors)
